headline: How to Get Scorchhowl
title: How to Get Scorchhowl in Aniimo | Flameruff Evolution Steps | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want Scorchhowl, the fiery final form of Emberpup? Head to Beast Fang Ridge. Emberpup becomes Flameruff at level twelve after you clear Sanctum First Spark. Then Flameruff becomes Scorchhowl at level twenty, but only after you defeat the Alpha Scorchhowl. The Thunderstorm form only shows up there during a thunderstorm. Which form will you hunt first? Comment below!
description: Scorchhowl in Aniimo comes from Emberpup in Beast Fang Ridge: Flameruff at level 12 after Sanctum First Spark, then Scorchhowl at level 20 after defeating the Alpha Scorchhowl.
